summary: Scope fetch-batch checkpoints per client, format, and unordered URL set; write one atomic completion marker per URL and return a failed exit on interrupted work.
reason: A shared URL-only checkpoint crossed jobs and tenants; read-modify-write JSON lost progress across simultaneous processes; input reorder changed identity, JSON null hid damaged state, and cancellation could report success with URLs never attempted.
validated_outcome: Synthetic tests prove concurrent completions survive, old JSON progress imports, reordered and duplicate URL lists share a checkpoint, null state fails, and cancellation reports every unfinished URL with a nonzero command result.
